title: extensions/authority/0.1: the organizations whose authority levels a service reads, the level each relayed action needs (DEC-0162) and whether it reads standing mandates (DEC-0166)
description: The value of the authority extension key https://fabric.passioncode.ai/agent-contract/extensions/authority/0.1 in a service's well-known document, beside the actions extension (DEC-0121 AP-1), which it never changes: a reader of the actions extension pinned before DEC-0162 ignores this key. A service that reads levels declares levels; the level an action needs is keyed by the action's id in the actions extension. A reader ignores a member it does not define (a later decision adds members to this key, as DEC-0166 adds standing and DEC-0172 the per-action declarations a decision verifier reads), so the root is open; the members it defines are closed. A checker reports an invalid value, an organization named twice and a level for an id that is not a relayed action of the actions extension as FAC-SEM-142. docs/specification/membership.md#levels.

standing.description: DEC-0166 AU-3: this service reads standing mandates (a place's autonomy profile, mandate/1 with standing); the hub forwards one, and an agent sends one directly, only to a service that declares it. Absent: the service reads none and answers a call carrying one as if it carried no mandate.

levels.description: DEC-0162 LV-5: the organizations whose levels this service reads, each with the audience that organization's issuer registered it by as an org-membership/2 reader; the hub fetches a level holder's attestation for that audience and binds it by mem. Absent: the service reads no levels (LV-10).

actionLevels.description: DEC-0162 LV-7: the lowest level that decides this relayed action in an organization: owner for a billing act (the organization's plan, its payment method, its invoices); operator for an act no level decides (a rule proposal's approval, type rule, proposals FAC-SEM-104; an owner's settlement is no relayed action); admin for a client key's relayed twin of an instance the organization deploys (DEC-0159 CF-3: the revoking twin; issuing or rotating a member's key stays CF-3's human step, decided and taken in person by the owner or an administrator, a member's own machine included (until the member-key door's proof is named (membership, Not decided), an instance the organization deploys on a member's machine offers no member-key issue or rotation)), an access grant at a gate, a spend limit (setting or changing a project's L1, a key's ceiling or an organization-wide total once one is specified), a board hold's set and lift, the move of a responder slot and a Project's listing and unlisting (project-comms), any other proposal type's approval and a credential request's decision offered as a relayed action (the operator's answers to questions 4 and 9, 2026-11-13). A source hand-over of an organization's own agent is declared admin: a route to a place the organization holds and only its members read is no hand-over, so no hand-over is an architect's (source, LV-6, the operator's answer of 2026-11-13). An action this map leaves out is decided by an architect in the call's project, by admin for a call in no project; an action whose effect is change-policy is read as admin at least, whatever this map says (the operator's answer to question 4).

actionEffects.description: DEC-0172 DV-5: the DL-3 effect class of each action, keyed by the action's id in the actions extension; a decision verifier classifies an act by it. Absent for an action: the capability's DL-3 effect is the floor.

decidingArgs.description: DEC-0172 DV-5: the names of the input members that decide each action (what a person would weigh), keyed by the action's id; a verifier shows them, never other arguments.

maxCostUsd.description: DEC-0172 DV-5, DV-7: each action's declared worst-case cost in USD, keyed by the action's id; a verifier compares it with the limits (asked.spendUsd).

targetArg.description: DEC-0172 DV-5: the input member that names the one object each action acts on, keyed by the action's id.

actionObject.description: DEC-0172 DV-5: a JSON Schema of the object each action's digest (DL-18) is computed over, keyed by the action's id, so a verifier can show a person the exact object before the call. Absent: the hub computes no digest; a T2 call still learns it from the callee's refusal.
